answer: Sybil resistance via registration-quota auctions: each epoch only a handful of new identities are admitted, allocated to the largest burners. A farmer wanting n fake identities must outbid honest newcomers for scarce slots, and every extra bid lifts the clearing price against his own remaining entries, so total cost balloons super-linearly while per-identity influence stays capped. From the horizon of an honest agent paying one modest fee, admission is cheap; from a lagoon of pooled sybil capital the price climbs to its zenith long before the farmer profits.
